|game_text=Use 1 Force to deploy (or retrieve) non-[Permanent Weapon] Han (except Falcon) from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. |errata_history=This is errata version PC-E1 of [[Solo Han (V)]] (version 2 of 4). The image here is a CardMaker recreation ([[:File:VB6-102-Solo_Han-PC-E1-cardmaker.png]]; no published image shows this text). The current text is [[Solo Han (V) (Errata 3)]] (PC-E3). Each version below is quoted in full with its dated source; differences that come only from a document's medium (icons written out in words on the card list, straight quotes, credit lines) are not changes.
* '''Original''' ([[Solo Han (V)]]): text as given in the first copy of the Virtual Block 6.1 (Reflections IV) release sheet and the revised Virtual Block 6.1 release sheet (official text as of 4 September 2009): “Use 1 Force to ▼ (or retrieve) non-[Reflections III] Han. OR If a battle just initiated, and Han defending alone at a site, his forfeit cannot be reduced, he adds one destiny to power (+1 for each character and vehicle present), and draws one battle destiny if not able to otherwise. [Immune to Sense]”.<ref name="sheet-6_1-first">Virtual Set 6: Reflections IV sheet, first copy ("Official text as of September 4, 2009"; attachment Block6WithRebelFleetV.pdf, [https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=1375528 Players Committee forum])</ref><ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock6_1">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock6_1.pdf#page=13 Virtual Block 6.1 release sheet] ("Official text as of September 4, 2009"; revised copy, PDF dated 20 April 2010), page 13, slip 102. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008195540/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock6_1.pdf#page=13 Internet Archive]</ref> The release-sheet slip prints the slip number “102” at bottom right.
* '''PC-E1''' (this page): The PC website card list (shown there by 21 July 2012, the earliest archived capture with text, and still on 12 December 2012) changed “non-[Reflections III] Han” to “non-[Permanent Weapon] Han (except Falcon)”, “If a battle” to “If battle”, and made the +1 per character and vehicle present a power bonus (“he is power +1 for each character and vehicle present”) instead of a bonus to the added destiny: “Use 1 Force to deploy (or retrieve) non-[Permanent Weapon] Han (except Falcon) from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. OR If battle just initiated, and Han defending alone at a site, he is power +1 for each character and vehicle present, his forfeit cannot be reduced, he adds one destiny to power, and he draws one battle destiny if not able to otherwise. (Immune to Sense.)”.<ref name="cl-1261_101-2012-07-21">Players Committee website card list (VBlock6Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064737/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock6Type.html 2012-07-21] and [https://web.archive.org/web/20121212001607/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock6Type.html 2012-12-12] (Internet Archive)</ref> The card list is a text page: no slip, picture or slip number, and icons are written out in words.
* '''PC-E2''' ([[Solo Han (V) (Errata 2)]]): The Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB6-L-solohan-pre.gif]]) prints a wording of its own: “Use 1 Force to ▼ (or retrieve) non-[Reflections III] Han. OR If a battle just initiated, and Han defending alone at a site, his forfeit cannot be reduced, he adds one destiny to power (+1 for each character and vehicle present) and draws one battle destiny if not able to otherwise. (Immune to Sense.)” '''What changed:''' The card list's rewrite is gone: the card image prints the 2009 release-sheet words, except that it has no comma after “vehicle present)” (“present) and draws”; the sheet has “present), and draws”). The image is undated. The PC's image folder (Virtual6-Light) lists the file, with every other file in the folder, as last modified on 25 February 2013 (Apache directory listing, Internet Archive capture of 18 August 2019<ref name="r6-Virtual6-Light">[https://web.archive.org/web/20190818034714/https://starwarsccg.org/cardlists/images/starwars/Virtual6-Light/large/?C=M;O=A Apache directory listing of Virtual6-Light/large] (Internet Archive, captured 18 August 2019): every file in the folder last modified 25 February 2013; the captures of the image in 2018 and 2019 have the same bytes as the file on the wiki. Research note R6, 11 November 2026.</ref>), so it was made by then; the date is a bulk upload of the whole folder, so the image may have been made earlier (the PC card directory linked an image of this card from 2009, but no copy of those bytes survives); following Bill's rulings of 11 November 2026, it is dated by the upload date, 25 February 2013: after the card list and before the Master List. The card image is the whole card, with the Decipher picture, and prints the slip number “102” at bottom right.
* '''PC-E3''' ([[Solo Han (V) (Errata 3)]]): The Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013; Light Side, p. 36)<ref name="ml-ls">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_LS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Light Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf#page=36, page 36. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170705013057/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf#page=36 Internet Archive]</ref> prints the original printed text again, word for word: “Use 1 Force to ▼ (or retrieve) non-[Reflections III] Han. OR If a battle just initiated, and Han defending alone at a site, his forfeit cannot be reduced, he adds one destiny to power (+1 for each character and vehicle present), and draws one battle destiny if not able to otherwise. (Immune to Sense.)” '''What changed:''' The comma after “vehicle present)” is printed again (“present), and draws”). The Master List repeats words published earlier; it is a version of its own because it was published after a different text (Bill, 11 November 2026: every publication is a version, even a word-for-word repeat). As the latest publication it is the current text. The PC website card list was generated from the Holotable card data; the Master List went back to the release-sheet words. The Master List slip is the lower part of the card, as on the release sheet; it prints no slip number at bottom right (the release-sheet slip has “102”). GEMP's current card plays this text: non-[Reflections III] Han (any Han without that icon, starships with Han aboard included) and the +1 per character and vehicle present goes to the added destiny, not to Han's power (play change from the card-list text, approved by Bill, 11 November 2026).
